notes.title: THE SPY UPDATE [v0.9.0.0] - Our third character is PLAYABLE NOW!!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36895661/3b2334672b4160e2350802a1a19b01c002fe0b7c.png

SPY TIME 🕵🏾‍♂️ SPY TIME

She's been a long time coming, but TODAY our third character, the Spy is playable!! ːsteamhappyː

She'll be getting a lot of balance changes over the next week or so, but I'm super psyched to finally have her out and playable! As you might expect of a weapons master, she's got a ton of really, really crazy tools. It's going to take some time to calibrate all of those, so please don't hesitate to share your feedback on our Discord server. Not gonna lie, I'm pretty sure she's overpowered right now, but we'll get her in a good spot soon. Thanks in advance for your help, everyone!

Have a blast! ( ‵▽′)ψ

Full patch notes here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/16LziGiOmpIVzc5mi0SJLsHqpmO6e-bIW_V4dQ045z-A/

notes.title: Fashionista Update! [v0.8.11] - Spectator mode, unlockables, bug fixes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36895661/b7e20ce17b9cf16d34563a20bbb42811859770f6.png
Welcome to the FASHIONISTA UPDATE!
Lots of additions & changes:Spectator mode added! - While in a private lobby, you can click your player icon to turn into a spectator. When creating a lobby, set it to 3 or 4 players so that the spectator can join, and voila! Coolest thing is that it shouldn't affect your ping as a player at all. Let's go Quantum!!
Street Creds added! - Our first unlockables system! Earn Street Creds (SC) in a variety of ways - by playing, checking the news, training... basically everything in the game earns you value now. We'll be adding content for you to unlock, but for now you can find the highly expensive bronze, silver, and especially golden skins for each character.
Reworked private lobbies - It's now much easier to set up a lobby and visually it's a lot nicer too.
Major stability updates - Great news especially to players who use Gamecube controllers: the bug that kept you from being able to use your controller online is now fixed! knock on wood
Major visibility improvements on Rooftops - Changed a lot about how the lighting, values, saturation, etc work on the Rooftops, so now it's WAY easier to tell what's going on. 
Minimal balance changes - This is a strange one to brag about, but with our first big tournament happening tomorrow we didn't want to create any major changes to the game right before the event. By the way... GO REGISTER! IT'S A FREE EVENT WITH CASH PRIZES! Next week's patch will be when we push out our major balance changes to the game.

Hope you enjoy! By the way... 

Go register for tomorrow's tournament!! We're giving out $1,000 in prizes for it, payouts to top 8, and it's FREE ENTRY. Check the link for more info.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36895661/d87a0f11f5788903bb47963df53e373537136f26.png

Next week we have another big update planned. Arguably a much bigger update ehehehe.....

Til then, good slayin!

notes.title: Patch 0.8.10 - Ranked leaderboards! And a bunch of other stuff, too!
notes.notes:
Surprise! There's actually three things to announce today!

First off, the game is on sale! SLAYERS is 10% off for the next week! Yahoo!

Second, we're implementing ranked leaderboards as of today!! φ(*￣0￣) Please note that this is essentially version 0.1 of the ranked mode. It's not got sets built in yet, and the formula itself is more or less untested beyond what we could do internally. I might make a vlog about it, but just know that ranked is going to continue to go through big changes over the course of the next few months, so please be patient with us. 

That said, I think this is going to make the game a lot more fun! There are 9 skill tiers, and once your 6 placement matches complete you'll be tossed into a tier. The ranks are probably a bit too volatile atm, but we really just need data to see how well my simulations are matching up with people's experiences. Good luck on the boards, people!

Finally, we've got a bunch of other stuff coming out with this patch! Here are a few things off the top of my head:
There's a pretty big backend overhaul to the UI that should make everything more stable
A fancy new results screen has been added in post-match
Color costumes are selectable in character select now! Along with previews of the character models!
The controls saving bug is I think fixed. Let me know if it's not and we'll get back on it!
In game visibility should be improved yet again. Probably won't be the last time this gets tweaked, but each time should help the game be easier to read :)
Some netcode tweaks got made thanks to our friends at Quantum. This will probably also continue getting tweaked, but I think this should be an improvement to the stability and feel of the netcode.
Focus is nerfed to be more punishable on whiff.
...and a bunch of other stuff, too! I need to get back into the habit of making full patch notes. Next time!
PHEW! That was a lot to cover! But one last thing... There are still more announcements to look out for over the next few weeks. This wasn't "the big one." ːsteammockingː Stay tuned, Slayers. And as always, thanks for your support!!

Alsoooo don't forget, the submission deadline for the combo video contest is May 7th! Get your vids in and you could win upwards of $100! More information on that here.
